verses.1: Hallelujah! Happy are those who fear the LORD, who greatly delight in God's commands.
verses.2: Their descendants shall be mighty in the land, generation upright and blessed.
verses.3: Wealth and riches shall be in their homes; their prosperity shall endure forever.
verses.4: They shine through the darkness, a light for the upright; they are gracious, merciful, and just.
verses.5: All goes well for those gracious in lending, who conduct their affairs with justice.
verses.6: They shall never be shaken; the just shall be remembered forever.
verses.7: They shall not fear an ill report; their hearts are steadfast, trusting the LORD.
verses.8: Their hearts are tranquil, without fear, till at last they look down on their foes.
verses.9: Lavishly they give to the poor; their prosperity shall endure forever; their horn shall be exalted in honor.
verses.10: The wicked shall be angry to see this; they will gnash their teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked come to nothing.

notes.text: Happy are those: literally, "Happy the person." "Person" is used typically, hence the plural translation.
Prosperity: literally, "justice." In the Second Temple Period the word acquired the nuance of liberality and almsgiving. Cf Sirach 3:30; 7:10; Matthew 6:1-4.
Their horn: the symbol for vitality and honor.
